title.zh: 超微承包商认罪：25亿美元服务器订单卷入走私案*
title.en: 超微承包商认罪：25亿美元服务器订单卷入走私案*

current_state.zh: Former Supermicro contractor Ting-Wei Sun pleaded guilty in a New York federal court to four charges for conspiring to smuggle Nvidia-powered AI servers to China as part of a scheme involving roughly $2.5 billion in orders and at least $510 million in illegally diverted equipment.
current_state.en: Former Supermicro contractor Ting-Wei Sun pleaded guilty in a New York federal court to four charges for conspiring to smuggle Nvidia-powered AI servers to China as part of a scheme involving roughly $2.5 billion in orders and at least $510 million in illegally diverted equipment.
